name: asc-cli-usage
activation: `command -v asc` succeeds, `asc auth status --validate` passes, and the user confirms a paid Apple Developer Program account.
prerequisites: A paid Apple Developer Program account.
The asc CLI on PATH with an App Store Connect API key (the .p8 key downloads only once).
risks: `asc web api-keys create --output-dir ./keys` (SKILL.md:59-62) writes a private key into the working folder; keep keys outside any repository.
asc sends telemetry by default; run it with ASC_TELEMETRY_DISABLED=1.
Never run `asc install-skills`: it installs the same 25 skill names at an older commit.
errata: SKILL.md:3 describes using asc 'in this repo', meaning the asc CLI repository, not the user's project.
